This request has a lower priority.
A request is less urgent than other work. State that it has a lower priority.
Lagere is the comparative adjective before de prioriteit. Deze aanvraag is singular with heeft; priority does not report completion.
Which task helps the most users?
You need to choose work by how many users it helps. Ask which task helps the most users.
Welke taak is the singular question subject of helpt. De meeste gebruikers is the plural object, not the subject.
We can do the cleanup after the disruption.
Cleanup can wait until after the disruption. Explain that order of work.
Kunnen takes bare infinitive doen. Na de storing places cleanup later than the disruption, rather than during it.
The team leader decides which report takes precedence.
The team leader decides which report goes first. Identify that priority decision maker.
Welke melding is the embedded singular subject of voorgaat. Voorgaan stays joined at the embedded clause's end.
A short task is not always the most important one.
A colleague assumes a short task is always the most important. Explain why duration does not determine importance.
Niet altijd means not always, not never. De belangrijkste stands for the most important task already understood from context.
S=De gevolgen|V=wegen|C=zwaarder|PP=dan de volgorde van binnenkomst.
The consequences carry more weight than the order of arrival.
Your team weighs consequences more heavily than arrival order. Explain that basis for priority.
Wegen is plural with de gevolgen. Zwaarder dan is a figurative comparison of importance, not physical weight.
Do we need to adjust the plan because of this?
A changed priority may affect the plan. Ask whether the team needs to adjust it because of that change.
Moeten asks about necessity. Hierdoor means because of this and is not a time phrase; aanpassen stays infinitive.
S=Ik|V=begin|PP=met de blokkade voor het hele team.
I start with the blocker affecting the entire team.
You start with the blocker affecting the whole team. State that first focus.
Beginnen met introduces the initial task. Voor het hele team identifies the people blocked; het hele team is singular.
What can wait without major consequences?
Some work may be safely deferred. Ask what can wait without major consequences.
Wat is the question subject of kan. Zonder grote gevolgen describes the consequences avoided; wachten is the bare infinitive.
If the impact changes, we review the priority again.
The team reviews priority again if impact changes. State that conditional review rule.
The fronted als-clause ends in verandert. Main-clause bekijken we follows it; opnieuw means again.
We have put the urgent request at the top of the list.
Your team moved an urgent request to the top of the list. Report that completed priority change.
Hebben gezet is perfect. Bovenaan de lijst gives the recorded position of de spoedaanvraag, the object moved.
The latest request does not automatically take precedence.
A colleague assumes the newest request automatically comes first. Reject that automatic priority rule.
Voorgaan splits as gaat ... voor. Niet automatisch rejects automatic precedence, not every possible reason to prioritise the latest request.
I allow another half hour for the report.
You allow an additional half hour for writing the report. State that added time allowance.
Voor het verslag is fronted, followed by reken ik. Nog een halfuur means another half hour in this estimate.
How long does just the first step take?
You need the duration of the first step separately. Ask how long only that step takes.
Hoe lang asks about duration. Alleen limits the subject to de eerste stap, which takes singular duurt.
We cannot predict the finish time precisely yet.
Your team cannot yet predict the finish time accurately. Explain the limit on that estimate.
Kunnen takes infinitive voorspellen. Nog niet precies qualifies predictive precision rather than claiming no information at all.
G=Als er geen extra fouten zijn,|V=zijn|S=we|T=voor de middag|C=klaar.
If there are no extra errors, we will be finished before noon.
You expect to finish before noon if no additional errors appear. State that conditional estimate.
The als-clause contains existential er and plural geen extra fouten. Main-clause zijn we klaar gives the completion estimate conditionally.
S=De voorbereiding|V=vraagt|O=meer tijd dan de uitvoering.
The preparation takes more time than the execution.
Preparation requires more time than execution. Compare the two amounts of effort.
Vraagt means requires here. Meer tijd dan compares time amounts; it does not mean somebody is asking a spoken question.
I have reserved extra time for the check.
You reserved extra time for a check. Report that completed time allowance.
Heb gereserveerd is perfect. Voor de controle identifies the purpose of the extra time, not a date before it.
The waiting time is not included in the estimate.
Waiting time was excluded from the estimate. Disclose that limit on its scope.
Is opgenomen describes inclusion in the estimate. Niet negates that inclusion; de wachttijd is the subject rather than an object.
Which assumption are we using for this estimate?
Your team needs to identify the assumption behind an estimate. Ask which assumption you are using.
Welke aanname is the question object and we the subject of gebruiken. Voor deze schatting identifies its purpose.
The second round will probably take us less time.
You expect the second round probably to take less time. Give that tentative comparison.
Kost agrees with de tweede ronde. Ons identifies whose time is required; waarschijnlijk keeps the prediction tentative.
I want to discuss the estimate with a colleague.
You want a colleague's view on an estimate. Say that you want to discuss it with a colleague.
Wil takes bare infinitive bespreken. De schatting is the topic, and met een collega names the discussion partner.
We note where the uncertainty lies.
Your team records where the uncertainty lies. Describe that documentation of uncertainty.
Waar introduces the embedded location question figuratively. De onzekerheid is singular with final zit; no literal sitting is meant.
An optimistic estimate is not a commitment yet.
A colleague treats an optimistic estimate as a promise. Explain that favourable estimation is not commitment yet.
Nog geen toezegging is a noun complement after is. Gunstige takes -e before singular de schatting.
Can you check just the final step?
You need a colleague to review the final step only. Ask for that narrowly scoped check.
Alleen de laatste stap limits the object checked. Kun ... controleren is a request, not a completed review.
PP=Voor de technische uitleg|V=vraag|S=ik|O=een ervaren collega.
For the technical explanation, I ask an experienced colleague.
You ask an experienced colleague for the technical explanation. State whom you approach for that help.
Voor de technische uitleg is fronted, followed by vraag ik. Een ervaren collega is the person approached, not the sentence's subject.
We can look at the task together with the intern.
Your team can review a task together with the intern. Offer that joint review.
Kunnen takes infinitive bekijken. Samen met de stagiair includes the intern in the review rather than transferring the entire task.
You are receiving help but still own the task. Clarify that responsibility remains with you.
Blijft expresses a continuing state. Bij mij identifies responsibility figuratively, not a physical location; the sentence contains no negation.
When do you have time to look at it with me?
A colleague could look at a problem with you, but timing is unclear. Ask when they have time.
Ruimte means available capacity here. Om mee te kijken names the joint review, with te between mee and kijken.
I have told my team leader about the knowledge I am missing.
You told your team leader about knowledge you lack. Report that completed communication of a skill gap.
Heb gemeld is perfect. De ontbrekende kennis names the gap reported; bij mijn teamleider identifies whom you informed.
Explain the first step to me once more.
You need the first step explained again. Ask a colleague to explain that step to you once more.
Uitleggen splits as imperative leg ... uit. Mij is the recipient of the explanation; de eerste stap is what is explained.
I also want to learn to carry out this task myself.
Alongside getting help, you want to learn to perform the task yourself. State that learning goal.
Wil takes leren without te, and leren uitvoeren names learning to perform the task. Zelf marks your intended independence.
We agree who checks which part.
Your team agrees who checks each part of the task. Describe that explicit division of checking.
Afspreken splits as spreken ... af. In wie welk deel controleert, wie is the subject and welk deel the object.
S=Een tweede blik|V=helpt|O=ons|TE=om fouten te vinden.
A second pair of eyes helps us find errors.
A second review helps your team find errors. Explain the value of another pair of eyes.
Ons is the direct object of helpt and the understood people doing vinden. Om fouten te vinden names what the second review helps achieve.
Can you follow up the request while I am away?
You need cover for a request while you are away. Ask a colleague to follow it up during your absence.
Kun ... opvolgen is a request. Tijdens mijn afwezigheid limits the requested coverage period; opvolgen remains joined as infinitive.
The colleague has only taken over the test.
A colleague took over the test only. Explain that limited transfer of work.
Heeft overgenomen is perfect. Alleen de test restricts what was transferred; it does not report complete ownership of the whole task.
The preparation has overrun by one day.
During your team planning discussion, preparation overran by one day. Report the duration of that overrun.
Is uitgelopen is perfect with zijn. Een dag measures the overrun rather than naming a new calendar date.
S=De oorzaak van het uitstel|V=is|NEG=niet|C=de test zelf.
The cause of the postponement is not the test itself.
A colleague blames the test itself for postponement, but that is incorrect. Correct that assumption.
De oorzaak is singular with is. De test zelf is a noun complement, and niet rejects that identification.
I can deliver the first part today.
You can deliver the first part today despite the wider delay. Offer that partial delivery.
Kan takes infinitive opleveren. Vandaag nog means still today; het eerste deel limits the offer to part of the work.
Who do we need to inform about the new date?
A date has changed and relevant people must be notified. Ask whom your team needs to inform.
Wie is the fronted question object; we is the subject of moeten. Over de nieuwe datum identifies the information to communicate.
S=Ik|V=verwacht|G=dat de extra controle een halfuur duurt.
I expect the extra check to take half an hour.
You expect an extra check to take thirty minutes. Give that duration estimate.
Verwacht expresses expectation. In the dat-clause, de extra controle is singular and duurt is final; een halfuur is thirty minutes.
S=De afspraak met de gebruiker|V=komt|A=hierdoor|C=in gevaar.
The appointment with the user is put at risk by this.
The current delay puts the user's appointment at risk. Explain that consequence.
Hierdoor means because of this. In gevaar komen is a figurative risk expression and does not say the appointment has already failed.
We have not confirmed the revised plan yet.
Your team has not confirmed the revised plan yet. State that pending status.
Hebben bevestigd is perfect. Nog niet means not yet and de gewijzigde planning is the object awaiting confirmation.
Can you estimate the consequences of the postponement?
The postponement may have consequences that need assessing. Ask a colleague to estimate its effects.
Kun precedes je, with joined infinitive inschatten. De gevolgen van het uitstel are the effects assessed, not an asserted diagnosis.
S=Een extra collega|V=lost|O=de wachttijd op goedkeuring|NEG=niet|PART=op.
An extra colleague does not remove the wait for approval.
Extra staff cannot remove the wait for approval. Explain why that dependency remains.
Oplossen splits as lost ... op. Niet negates removing the approval wait; de wachttijd op goedkeuring is the object.
G=Als de levering morgen komt,|V=blijft|S=de einddatum|C=haalbaar.
If the delivery comes tomorrow, the final date remains achievable.
The final date remains achievable if the delivery arrives tomorrow. Give that condition for keeping the deadline.
Als introduces the delivery condition. The fronted clause is followed by blijft de einddatum; haalbaar is a predicate adjective.
S=Ik|V=houd|O=de opdrachtgever|C=op de hoogte van de vertraging.
I keep the requester informed about the delay.
You will keep the requester informed about the delay. State that communication commitment.
Iemand op de hoogte houden means keep someone informed. De opdrachtgever is the direct object; van de vertraging names the topic.
Record the new date only after confirmation.
A proposed date is not confirmed yet. Tell a colleague to record the new date only after confirmation.
Noteer is imperative. Pas na bevestiging delays recording until confirmation, rather than requiring immediate entry as a final date.
The workload is high this afternoon.
This afternoon's workload is high. Describe that workload to your team leader.
In this Belgian schedule context deze middag means this afternoon. Hoog is a predicate adjective after is, with no -e.
I can pick up the new report early tomorrow.
You can start handling a new report early tomorrow. Offer that realistic start time.
Kan takes joined infinitive oppakken. Morgen vroeg means early tomorrow; this offers a start, not guaranteed completion.
The team needs additional help today. Ask who still has available capacity.
Wie is the question subject of heeft. Nog ruimte means remaining capacity and vandaag limits the question to today.
The preparation time must not disappear.
Preparation time must remain in the schedule. State that it must not disappear.
Mag niet expresses prohibition. Verdwijnen remains infinitive; de voorbereidingstijd is the subject whose allocation is protected.
I discuss the workload with my supervisor.
You discuss workload with the person supervising your work. Describe that discussion.
Bespreken takes de werkdruk as direct object. Met mijn begeleider names the discussion partner; no over is needed before the topic.
Your team has redistributed the tasks. Report that completed change in allocation.
Hebben verdeeld is perfect. Opnieuw means again and describes redistribution; it is an adverb rather than a preposition phrase.
Can you take over the telephone follow-up this afternoon?
You need cover for telephone follow-up this afternoon. Ask a colleague to take over that specific work.
Kun ... overnemen is a request. Vanmiddag gives the afternoon coverage period and de telefonische opvolging limits the work transferred.
I indicate which tasks I can handle today.
You identify which tasks you can manage today. Describe making your daily capacity explicit.
Aangeven splits as geef ... aan. Aankan stays joined at the embedded clause's end and means can handle, not formal permission.
There is still time for one short check.
There is still capacity for one brief check. Identify that limited remaining time.
Er introduces existence, with singular tijd as the subject of blijft. Voor één korte controle specifies the use of that remaining time.
Today's agreement excludes some work. Ask which work lies outside its scope.
Wat is the question subject of valt. Buiten de afspraak describes scope, not a time; voor vandaag limits the agreement to today.
I do not promise a finish time without a feasible plan.
You will not promise a finish time without a workable plan. State that limit on commitments.
Geen eindtijd negates an indefinite finish time. Zonder een haalbare planning gives the missing prerequisite for promising one.
G=Wanneer de spoedklus klaar is,|V=bekijken|S=we|O=de rest.
When the urgent job is finished, we review the rest.
The team will review remaining work when the urgent job is complete. State that review trigger.
Wanneer introduces the completion trigger. Its fronted clause ends in klaar is, followed by main-clause bekijken we de rest.
The plan also includes time for recovery.
The plan includes recovery time as well as normal work. Explain that additional allowance.
Bevat agrees with singular de planning. Ook adds recovery time; tijd voor herstel allocates time rather than proving recovery will succeed.
Which confirmation do we need first?
Your team needs a confirmation before proceeding, but it is unclear which. Ask which confirmation comes first.
Welke bevestiging is the question object, we the subject. Hebben ... nodig expresses need; eerst orders the required confirmations.
G=Nadat de gegevens zijn ontvangen,|V=controleren|S=we|O=de volledigheid.
After the data has been received, we check its completeness.
Your team checks data completeness after receipt. State that sequence of work.
Nadat marks the earlier receipt. Zijn ontvangen is passive perfect with plural de gegevens; main-clause controleren we follows the fronted clause.
We can update the manual in the meantime.
Your team can update the manual while waiting for a dependency. Suggest that productive work in the meantime.
Kunnen takes joined infinitive bijwerken. Ondertussen means in the meantime and permits useful parallel work without claiming the dependency is resolved.
The second task does not have to wait.
A second task has no need to wait for the blocked one. Explain that it can proceed independently.
Hoeft niet te wachten means does not have to wait. It removes necessity rather than forbidding waiting.
I coordinate the plan with the evening shift.
You coordinate the plan with the evening shift. Describe that planning coordination.
Afstemmen splits as stem ... af. Met de avonddienst identifies the shift consulted, not the recipient of a completed handover.
Can we divide the checks into two rounds?
You want checks spread across two rounds. Ask whether the team can divide them that way.
Kunnen we introduces the proposal. In twee rondes gives the distribution structure and verdelen stays infinitive.
We do not yet know when the device will arrive.
The device's arrival time is still unknown to your team. State that uncertainty.
Wanneer introduces the embedded time question. Het toestel is singular with final aankomt; nog niet limits the knowledge available so far.
I have described the dependencies in the ticket.
You documented the task dependencies in the ticket. Report where you have described them.
Heb beschreven is perfect with irregular participle beschreven. In het ticket locates the documented dependencies, not the task's execution.
What happens if the delivery fails to arrive?
A delivery might fail to arrive. Ask what happens if that contingency occurs.
Wat is the main question subject. Als introduces the condition and uitblijft stays joined; it describes non-arrival rather than merely a late clock time.
The handover must take place before the shift change.
The handover must happen before the shift changes. State that timing constraint.
Moet takes infinitive plaatsvinden, which remains joined. Voor de dienstwissel sets the deadline before the shift change.
If the date changes, we adjust the follow-up appointment.
A changed date requires adjusting the follow-up appointment. State that conditional adjustment rule.
The fronted als-clause ends in verschuift. Aanpassen splits as passen ... aan in the main clause, with we as subject.
